title: CSCI 101 — Principles of Computing
subject: Programming and Languages
description: An independent, catalog-aligned learning companion. It is not an official RIT course section or a replacement for the instructor's syllabus.
outcomes: Students will define and explain the core concepts of computing, including the relationship between hardware, software, and data.
Students will demonstrate the ability to break down a problem into sequential, executable steps using pseudocode or a programming language.
Students will articulate how computing impacts daily life and the world, and practice oral and written communication through structured assignments.
